title: Unary Family on Accepted Words
statement: Let $L$ be a language over the Boolean alphabet and let $n\in\mathbb N$. If the word consisting of $n$ copies of true belongs to $L$, then the circuit of the unary family for inputs of length $n$ is the all-ones circuit on $n$ inputs.
hypotheses_covered: The word of $n$ copies of true belongs to $L$
